script_text: The veil is thinning tonight, Spirit Animals, and the cosmos demands your immediate attention. Your karmic lesson requires you to confront the North Node in the 4th House, releasing Retrograde anxieties from your past to claim your spiritual birthright. Chiron’s bite will only fade when you stop running from emotional vulnerability. Meditate under the moonlight to ground this intense Mercury energy. Comment your sign below to claim your destiny.
